name: @examples/extension-query
//dependencies: @tanstack/react-query is installed so the authored source in src/App.tsx gets real
types and editor completion while it is written as an ordinary npm import. The #13
`extension` decision maps the package to the verified tanstack-query Forguncy
Frontend Extension (global `TanStackQuery`), so the compiler externalizes every
import of it and the npm implementation never enters the generated Cell artifact.
The pinned version therefore shapes types only: runtime identity belongs to the
extension bundle the page loads, not to this install.
